concerns.text: T014b-GEN (GPU Generation) is marked as [P] (parallel-safe) in the task list header, but the 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section explicitly states it is 'NOT parallel-safe due to sequential dependencies' (specifically depending on T012). Marking a task with hidden dependencies as [P] violates the parallel-safety contract.

T017b-1 (Semantic Similarity) is marked as [P] in the task list, but the 'Dependencies' section states it depends on T012. A task with a hard dependency on a prior task cannot be parallel-safe with respect to that prior task. The [P] tag is misleading and violates the 'Producer before consumer' ordering principle.

T022-1 (Matching) depends on T017b-1, T017b-2, T014b-GEN, and T014. However, the 'Parallel Opportunities' section claims 'All Foundational tasks marked [P] can run in parallel' and implies US1/US2 can run in parallel. T022-1 cannot start until T017b-1 (US1) completes, creating a hidden cross-phase dependency that breaks the claimed independence of US2.

T033a (Cohort Analysis) depends on T014b-VAL. T014b-VAL depends on T014b-GEN. T014b-GEN is in Phase 3. T033a is in Phase 6. The 'User Story Dependencies' section claims US4 can start after Foundational (Phase 2), but it actually requires Phase 3 completion (T014b-GEN). This violates the 'Foundational tasks first' and 'Producer before consumer' ordering.

T020 (Significance Flagging) is listed in Phase 3 (US1) but depends on T024 (Statistical Test) which is in Phase 4 (US2). This creates a circular or out-of-order dependency where a US1 task waits for a US2 artifact, breaking the 'independently-shippable unit' requirement for User Story 1.
